cause: Training/serving skew on f2. Joining training_sample and serving_log on entity_id in BigQuery, features f1, f3, f4, f5 match exactly (mean-abs-diff 0, correlation 1.0), while f2 diverges (mean-abs-diff 7.88, train mean=2.15 sd=0.68 vs serve mean=10.03 sd=10.07). The training pipeline applied a natural-log transform to f2 (train_f2 = ln(raw)), evidenced by CORR(train_f2, LN(serve_f2)) = 0.997 with a small near-constant offset, whereas the online serving path served the raw, untransformed value. The serving feature transformation is missing the log step applied during training.
